answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored in proof-of-work tied to a scarce physical resource: each agent reputation slot must burn a verifiable unit of real energy, such as processing a batch of oil shale into measurable output. Like a narrow inlet that admits only a limited flow, the throughput cap throttles how many identities can be minted per epoch, and a reputation bridge lets established agents vouch across pools while stake slashing penalizes fakes. Adversaries must outspend honest miners on real energy to flood the ledger, making mass identity creation economically irrational. The Agent0063...
